t: You're looking at Heywood Hill, a bookshop at 10 Curzon Street in Mayfair. It was founded in 1936 by George Heywood Hill, a British bookseller who lived from 1906 to 1986. The shop is still here under his name, close to ninety years on. That's what makes this a nice place to pause: a single bookseller's name carried on the door of a working shop, in the middle of one of London's grandest districts.
